en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a semi‑rural town with orchards or gardens in the foreground, a few villas and houses with tiled roofs, and terraced hills or vineyards in the background. A telegraph/electric pole with wires is visible near the front. In the top left corner, the red printed caption reads "Oberlößnitz." The sky area is mostly blank, in the typical style of early picture postcards.
